formate.intro: ISE Foundation is the A2 exam. Reading & Writing takes 2 hours; Speaking & Listening takes about 13 minutes, one-to-one with an examiner (by video conference at some centres). Each skill gets its own result.

formate.intro: ISE I is the B1 exam. Reading & Writing takes 2 hours (20 + 20 + 40 + 40 minutes); Speaking & Listening takes about 18 minutes including 2 minutes of admin time. Each skill gets its own result.

rows.what: Task 1, Long reading, questions 1–5: choose a title for each paragraph
rows.type: Title matching (six titles, five are used)
rows.time: 120 minutes for Reading and Writing together; 20 minutes each for Tasks 1 and 2

rows.type: An exact word, number or phrase from the texts (maximum three words)

rows.what: Task 3, Reading into writing: answer a question using information from all four Task 2 texts
rows.type: Free writing, 100–130 words
rows.time: same 120 minutes; 40 minutes each for Tasks 3 and 4

rows.what: Task 4, Extended writing: e.g. an email, article, review or essay
